add.issue.name: Live follow sticks on one comment when a newer one lands on the same ticket

edit.description.md: Following the log, a new comment on the ticket already open on its comments tab did nothing: `sameDestination` compared ticket and tab, not the comment, so it counted as "already there". Now it compares the comment too; an edit to the focused comment still stays put.

add.issue.comment.md: Review (claude/reviewer): a deleted comment became a destination, so follow jumped off the reader's comment onto a gone one. Fixed in #534: deletes carry no comment, and a target without one matches any comment on that tab.
add.issue.comment.author: TXACWM9V78DKD1MMT80F83TVYV

add.issue.comment.md: Review (claude/reviewer): opening the commit already in the URL did nothing, as the focus key didn't change. Fixed in #535: openCommitDiff bumps a counter the fold and scroll key on; the e2e folds it by hand and opens it again.
add.issue.comment.author: TXACWM9V78DKD1MMT80F83TVYV

add.issue.name: The Diff switch stays usable on a ticket opened at one commit

edit.description.md: Opening a linked commit from the log lands on the ticket's Code tab with `?commit=`, and `DiffViewSwitch` was disabled while any commit link was in the URL, so Diff only came back after switching tabs. Now the switch stays enabled: choosing Diff drops the commit link and shows the whole change.
